Earth from Space: Namibia’s biggest salt pan

This image from Copernicus Sentinel-2, acquired on 5 April 2026, shows the Etosha National Park in northern Namibia.

The area is a game reserve featuring a large salt flat, the Etosha Pan, with vegetation shown in red in this false-colour image.

The Etosha Pan, which spans roughly 130 km from east to west and covers 4760 sq km, appears bright white to human eyes.
